svg.title: Recommendation request — session and retrieval decisions

g.text: Recommendation request — session and retrieval decisions
Pending question, last action, displayed book ranks/titles
Command fast paths do not load session context.
The AI fallback receives only bounded reference context.
Parser output does not decide final session behavior.
Parser and response chat models can differ.
Load session and run the transition.
Capture request ID and intent for failure logs
Resolve, validate and complete the turn
Snapshot saved preferences and recommendation count
Keep search, queue and pending question unchanged
Remove matching saved opposite semantic tastes
Category overflow is caught by SessionTransitionService.
Keep saved preferences and the prior pending question;
save a repeatable limit outcome instead of returning 400.
Reuse displayed page or saved outcome
Intent handler resolves context and preferences
Read IDs, or logged fail-open on failure/oversize
Filter pending books against read/shown IDs
Build fresh batch, excluding read/shown IDs and cached tail
Run ordered retrieval strategies (up to 50 candidates)
Rank up to 20 recommendations with weighted scorers
[Count, reset preferences, history, help, cancel or unknown action]
Commit session if lock and version still match
Run afterCommit with selected page and decision
Generate wording using resolved decision and context
Preference reports list all required/excluded constraints first,
then styles, then genres/topics within the remaining word budget.
Exact constraints are never truncated, including on REPEAT.
Busy lock: 409. Lost lock or rejected commit: 503.
